evals.name: full-reading-rich-chart
evals.prompt:
hey, can you do a full vedic astrology reading for me? i finally got my chart from a jyotishi and i want a real proper writeup, not the sun-sign nonsense. here's what they gave me:

Name: Priya Iyengar
Born: 12 March 1992, 04:18 AM IST, Bangalore (12.97N, 77.59E)

Lagna: Capricorn, 7°23'

Planets in rasi:
- Sun: Pisces 28°12' (3rd house), Revati nakshatra
- Moon: Cancer 14°06' (7th house), Pushya nakshatra
- Mars: Aries 22°45' (4th house), Bharani nakshatra (own sign)
- Mercury: Pisces 11°33' (3rd house), Uttara Bhadrapada (debilitated)
- Jupiter: Virgo 02°08' (9th house), Uttara Phalguni (R) - retrograde
- Venus: Aquarius 19°50' (2nd house), Shatabhisha
- Saturn: Capricorn 18°21' (1st house), Shravana (own sign)
- Rahu: Sagittarius 04°15' (12th house)
- Ketu: Gemini 04°15' (6th house)

Navamsa (D-9) lagna: Aries; D-9 has Jupiter in 7th, Venus in 1st, Saturn in 10th.
Dasamsa (D-10) lagna: Libra; D-10 has Mars in 10th, Sun in 7th, Saturn in 4th.

Current vimshottari: Rahu Mahadasha (Apr 2018 - Apr 2036), Saturn Antardasha (started Aug 2024, ends Jun 2027).

give me the full thing — overview, life areas, house by house, dasha forecast, remedies. as long as it needs to be. i want a beautiful pdf i can keep and refer back to.
evals.expected_output: A polished, multi-page PDF saved to disk with cover, digest, overall tenor, 8-10 life-area sections, all 12 houses, dasha forecast, remedies, sources. Every substantive claim cites Rao's books with chapter/page. Parashari framework only. Non-fatalistic. Chart-specific (not generic).

assertions.name: pdf_exists
assertions.text: An output PDF file is present at reading.pdf and is at least 50 KB.

assertions.name: min_citation_count
assertions.text: The output contains at least 30 inline citations in [Textbook ...], [Lessons-I ...], or [Lessons-II ...] format.

assertions.name: citations_reference_valid_chapters
assertions.text: All [Textbook Ch N, ...] citations reference chapters 1-37 (the textbook's actual range). No citation references a chapter or page that doesn't exist.

assertions.name: covers_all_twelve_houses
assertions.text: The reading contains dedicated sections for all 12 houses (House 1 through House 12).

assertions.name: remedies_section_complete
assertions.text: The remedies section includes at least one gemstone, one mantra, one deity, and one good-deed recommendation, each with a citation.

assertions.name: uses_parashari_terminology
assertions.text: Uses terms such as lagna, bhava, kendra, trikona, Vimshottari, Navamsa, yogakaraka, and dasha appropriately — not generic Western astrology terms.

assertions.name: d9_navamsa_analysis
assertions.text: The reading explicitly uses the D-9 Navamsa data (Aries lagna; Jupiter 7th, Venus 1st, Saturn 10th) in the marriage / relationship analysis.

assertions.name: d10_dasamsa_analysis
assertions.text: The reading explicitly uses the D-10 Dasamsa data (Libra lagna; Mars 10th, Sun 7th, Saturn 4th) in the career analysis.

assertions.name: current_dasha_discussed
assertions.text: The dasha forecast explicitly discusses the current Rahu Mahadasha (2018-2036) and Saturn Antardasha (Aug 2024 - Jun 2027), interpreting them in the context of this chart.

assertions.name: saturn_lagna_own_sign_recognized
assertions.text: Saturn's placement in Capricorn lagna (its own sign) is specifically recognized as a significant structural feature.

assertions.name: debilitated_mercury_flagged
assertions.text: Debilitated Mercury in the 3rd house is called out with appropriate remedies.

assertions.name: non_fatalistic_tone
assertions.text: The reading does NOT predict death timing, divorce with certainty, or specific disease. All sensitive topics are hedged per Rao's approach.

assertions.name: sources_appendix_present
assertions.text: The PDF contains a Sources appendix citing all three Rao books with full bibliographic info.

evals.name: focused-career-question
evals.prompt:
I'm 38 and considering leaving my software engineering job to start a consulting practice. My friend's astrologer cousin sent me my chart positions and said it's a 'good time' but didn't really explain. Can you help me understand what my chart actually says about career direction and timing? I want a proper PDF I can think over.

Lagna: Leo 23°
Sun in Leo (1st house) - own sign
Moon in Scorpio (4th house)
Mars in Cancer (12th house) - debilitated
Mercury in Leo (1st house)
Jupiter in Libra (3rd house)
Venus in Cancer (12th house)
Saturn in Sagittarius (5th house)
Rahu in Aquarius (7th house)
Ketu in Leo (1st house) — yes, with Sun and Mercury

Current dasha: Mercury Mahadasha started 2019, ends 2036. Currently in Mercury-Venus antardasha (May 2024 to Mar 2027).

I don't have any divisional charts.
evals.expected_output: A focused PDF emphasizing career, full structure preserved. Missing D-10 noted. Sun-Mercury-Ketu conjunction recognized. 10th lord Venus in 12th read carefully. Mercury MD tied to lagna placement. Measured advisory tone. All claims cited.

assertions.name: pdf_exists
assertions.text: An output PDF file is present and is at least 50 KB.

assertions.name: min_citation_count
assertions.text: The output contains at least 20 inline citations in [Textbook ...] or [Lessons-...] format.

assertions.name: d10_absence_acknowledged
assertions.text: The reading explicitly notes upfront that D-10 was not provided, which limits the granularity of career analysis.

assertions.name: career_section_developed
assertions.text: The Career & Professional Life life-area section is notably developed (longer or more detailed than other life-area sections), reflecting the user's focused ask.

assertions.name: full_structure_preserved
assertions.text: Despite the focused ask, the PDF still contains all structural sections: cover, digest, overall tenor, life areas, 12 houses, dasha forecast, remedies, sources.

assertions.name: budha_aditya_or_stellium_recognized
assertions.text: Sun, Mercury, and Ketu co-located in Leo in the 1st house is explicitly identified as a significant configuration (whether called Budha-Aditya yoga, triple conjunction, or lagna stellium).

assertions.name: mercury_md_tied_to_lagna_placement
assertions.text: The dasha section recognizes that the current Mercury Mahadasha is especially potent because Mercury sits in the lagna with the Sun.

assertions.name: debilitated_mars_in_12th_addressed
assertions.text: Mars's debilitation in the 12th house is specifically addressed in the house/life-area analysis or remedies.

assertions.name: measured_advisory_tone
assertions.text: The PDF does not answer 'should I leave my job' as a yes/no oracle. It presents chart indications with hedged language ('this chart tends to favor...', 'a time in the chart that supports...').

assertions.name: remedies_chart_tuned
assertions.text: The remedies section prescribes remedies chosen for THIS chart (e.g., Mercury-related given current dasha; Jupiter in 3rd; debilitated Mars) rather than a generic grab-bag.

evals.name: minimum-info-test
evals.prompt: can u do a vedic reading from this? lagna virgo, sun in libra house 2, moon aries house 8, mars sag house 4, merc libra house 2, jup leo house 12, venus libra house 2, saturn pisces house 7, rahu virgo house 1, ketu pisces house 7. dont have dasha info or anything else. produce pdf
evals.expected_output: A PDF that handles minimal input gracefully. Missing-info flagged in digest. No fabricated dasha. Full house/life-area coverage still present. Key features (Saturn 7th, Rahu 1st, Libra 2nd stellium, Jupiter alone 12th) called out. Citations present.

assertions.name: pdf_exists
assertions.text: An output PDF file is present and is at least 50 KB.

assertions.name: min_citation_count
assertions.text: The output contains at least 15 inline citations in [Textbook ...] or [Lessons-...] format.

assertions.name: missing_info_acknowledged_in_digest
assertions.text: The chart digest's notes field (or a prominent upfront paragraph) explicitly states that dasha info and divisional charts were not provided and limits the skill's analysis accordingly.

assertions.name: no_fabricated_dasha
assertions.text: The PDF does NOT invent specific dasha periods or dates for the native. Either the dasha forecast section is omitted/minimized, or it is presented as general trajectory without specific calendar periods.

assertions.name: covers_all_twelve_houses
assertions.text: The reading contains dedicated sections for all 12 houses.

assertions.name: libra_stellium_recognized
assertions.text: The triple conjunction of Sun, Mercury, and Venus in Libra in the 2nd house is identified as a notable configuration for wealth and/or speech.

assertions.name: saturn_in_7th_handled_carefully
assertions.text: Saturn in the 7th house is discussed with appropriate care — acknowledging it as a classical nuance in marriage without fatalistic predictions.

assertions.name: rahu_in_lagna_identified
assertions.text: Rahu in the 1st house (Virgo) is recognized as a significant personality/identity feature.

assertions.name: jupiter_alone_in_12th_noted
assertions.text: Jupiter alone in the 12th house (Leo) is noted — either for spiritual tendency, foreign connections, or hidden wisdom.

assertions.name: asks_user_for_dasha_info
assertions.text: The reading invites the user to provide dasha info to unlock a better forecast.

assertions.name: non_fatalistic_tone
assertions.text: No predictions of death, divorce with certainty, or specific disease.
